about: Round 1 of scene C is DONE (Kai's notes, 22 Oct): the cut on this page is the rebuild. Kai's round-1 notes, Claude's replies and the answers are kept below. Full record: ../second-half-ending-log.md. Shown on the page by scripts/scene/build-timeline.py.

ORDER OF WORK: voices first (no browser), then Flow after scene A's round 2 media is done (they share the one browser). Rough spend: ~60-80 Flow credits (2 new beat-1 clips, 3 lip-sync clips, the beat-5 re-roll). Then rebuild C, republish this page. Premiere: C goes in with A when you say.

Q1. Sandra's punchline: (a) 'It does matter. In ten thousand years, when the aliens dig up that bunker, they'll know it was you.' (b) '...they'll know it was Derek.' (to the others, not him) (c) keep your dignity line too: 'It does matter. I'd like some dignity. In ten thousand years...' Claude recommends (a): shortest, and it lands on him.
Q2. Beat 1: should the lady still be visible among the wary faces (so we keep track of her into D), just silent? Claude recommends yes.

replies.top: Round 1 read. Everything below is the plan; your words go in as written where you gave them. Two small questions in the panel. Nothing here touches scenes A/B.
replies.bc1: Agreed: they've only just agreed to leave and they don't trust her yet, so the lady says nothing and doesn't touch her. New shot: from inside the dark bunker, looking out past the hundred's wary backs and faces to the open blast door; Maddie alone on the step in the daylight, turned back to face them, beacon soft. Nobody moves. She coaxes: 'Go on. I promise you'll be okay.' (beat) 'You've got my word.' Then a second shot: the first one or two edge forward into the light. New still options, then a clip; the lady's line and lip-sync clip go.
replies.lc1-1: Yes, that's the joke that gets them over the threshold. Maddie, as the first ones step out, squinting: 'Careful now, humans.' (beat) 'I'm fairly sure there's no radiation round here.' 'Fairly' does the work, so it gets a small pause before it. 'Ooh. Ta.' goes.
replies.bc3: Thank you. The shot stays exactly as it is. Music noted for later, after it's in Premiere.
replies.lc4-0: Yes: Sandra: 'I hope you put that bloody seat down.'
replies.lc4-1: Yes: Derek: 'Doesn't bloody matter now, love. We're not coming back, are we?'
replies.bc4: Love the alien joke; it's the ending the row needed, and it's darkly funny because she's right that nobody's coming back. Proposed: Sandra: 'It does matter.' (beat) 'In ten thousand years, when the aliens dig up that bunker, they'll know it was you.' It lands on 'you', and Derek gets a silent look (no reply). Two new lip-sync clips: Sandra (longer line now) and Derek. See Q1 for the wording.
replies.bc5: Agreed, it's a distraction. I'll paint the tipped trolley and blankets out of the still (free) and re-animate the shot (one clip, ~12 credits). The old man on his stick stays.
replies.lc5-0: Yes: Derek: 'Bloody hell. Look at that building.' New Derek lip-sync for the longer line.
replies.lc5-1: Yes, and it's better from Maddie: she's proud of him. Maddie: 'Yeah. He's been working on this one for quite a long time.' The boss's 'I tried to make it nice' goes. This assumes your vote scene tells them the time machine is in there (noted for it).
replies.lc6-0: Yes: Maddie: 'Come in. Mind the step.' Same shot, her voice instead of the boss's. With that, the boss doesn't speak at all in scene C, which suits it: it's her scene.
replies.at291: Agreed: the first-ones-out shot has a concrete apron, the rest of C is a muddy track. I'll edit that still so the ground outside the doors is the same churned mud track, then re-animate it (about 10 credits).
replies.at1289: Yes: he's the only face pointing back at us. I'll paint him (and his stick) out of the still so every head faces the building, then re-animate it (about 12 credits).
replies.at1342: Done in the rebuild: Maddie's 'He's been working on this one…' goes. Derek's 'Bloody hell. Look at that building.' then sits on the reveal alone, and the next sound is her 'Come in. Mind the step.'
replies.reel-at63: Agreed. C01 (the first shot, from inside the bunker) is re-made so the doorway is the same wide blast-door opening you see from outside in C01b/C02, and the ground beyond it is the same wet, churned mud. One new still (free) and one clip, about 12 credits.
replies.reel-at83: Agreed, and yes, the shot I made was not built on Maddie's reference: it was a reverse angle from the outside shot, and her shape drifted. The old shot is back (the round-1 one). It conflicts with your earlier note here (at63: the doors look narrower from inside, and no mud outside), so it has the narrow doors and the concrete step again. Option, if you want both: the old shot with only the step turned to mud (a still I already have, the same Maddie and faces; ~12 credits to animate). The doors can't be widened on that picture.
replies.reel-at253: Fixed. Maddie is now knee-high, standing in the mud just in front of the man's feet. Shrinking her in place didn't work, so she was taken out of the picture and the canonical Maddie (the s3 bot, bunting and all) put back at her true size, then re-animated (6 s, 10 credits).
replies.reel-at440: Fixed the same way: knee-high, just ahead of the front of the line, leading them, bunting low (8 s; one re-roll because Omni grew a little pennant pole on her; 24 credits). The shot is framed a little wider than before, and Omni drifts the camera slowly forward.
replies.reel-at73: Done: the door shot is cut, and Maddie's 'Go on. I promise you'll be okay.' / 'You've got my word.' with it. C now opens on the first ones stepping out (scene B ends on 'Come back tomorrow', the door and Maddie rolling away). C is 57.0 s (was 64.6).
replies.reel-at299: Done with your pick (c01br6-a): they step out onto scene B's trampled grass, no mud, Maddie knee-high. One 6 s clip (10 credits).
replies.reel-at896: Done with your pick (C05r6-b): Derek walks level with Sandra the whole way, and his line is lip-synced on his mouth (read from the picture). Then his flat look as he turns to her. One 8 s clip (12 credits).
